# Josie Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020)</sub>

## Appearance

Josie is considered fat for a girl her age, though she is noted to have a natural gift for walking board fences.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014)_

## Personality

Josie Pye is known among her peers for her malicious, sulky, and cheating behavior. She possesses a prominent streak of vanity and self-importance, frequently exhibiting a triumphant and taunting demeanor toward others. She is also regarded as sharp-tongued, lacking imagination, and generally unlikable.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c25 P47](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0047), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c31 P8](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0008), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c37 P32](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0032)_

## History

Josie attended the Avonlea school, where she competed with Anne Shirley and other pupils. During a spelling lesson, she was caught peeping in her book by Anne, which led her to spell a word wrong out of embarrassment. At a party hosted by Diana Barry, Josie boasted about her ability to walk a board fence and subsequently dared Anne to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's kitchen roof, leading to Anne's fall and a broken ankle. Josie later joined Miss Stacy's class preparing for the entrance examination to Queen's Academy, though she was disgruntled at being cast as a maid of honor rather than the Fairy Queen in a school concert. She passed her entrance examinations, was promoted into the fifth class at school, and went on to attend Queen's Academy, eventually graduating with a Second Class teacher's license alongside her classmates. After graduating, she decided to return to Queen's for further education rather than seek a teaching position.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P30](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0030), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c36 P23](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0023), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)_
